scope: First solo desktop/mobile browser test build; Discord, multiplayer, backend, monetization and full release excluded.

checkpoints.title: Confirm browser solo baseline
acceptance: CI passing on exact candidate SHA
Three playable heroes and five-wave boss loop match GDD
Functional gaps documented with links to evidence

checkpoints.title: Validate approved art and game presentation
acceptance: Reconcile in-game art gaps with GDD and ASSET_POLICY
No new asset generation without owner approval

checkpoints.title: Validate desktop and mobile controls
acceptance: Browser tests on exact candidate SHA
Real Android and iOS landscape playtests
Fullscreen, joystick, pause and modal handling verified

checkpoints.title: Validate full runs and balance
acceptance: Reproducible genuine-damage full runs for three heroes
Record seeds, builds, damage, waves, boss and results
Human playtests and balance conclusions reviewed

checkpoints.title: Validate stability and device performance
acceptance: TypeScript, Vitest, build and Playwright green on final SHA
Reliability and performance checked on reference devices

checkpoints.title: Vercel preview and owner acceptance
acceptance: Live HTTPS preview manually verified playable
Known scope gaps and limitations documented
Explicit owner approval for merge and PoC acceptance
